name: apple-fm
description: Apple Foundation Models integration for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.name: fm
plugins.description: Lend existing tools to Apple's on-device model through program callbacks. Prepare context and authorized tool scope once. Codex uses scripts/fm_host.js with actual host callbacks. Claude uses scripts/fm_claude.py with claude mcp serve or selected MCP servers. Scripts feed results to FM without host LLM callback turns. Use fm:ask for setup and permissions.
